source: Two curated outdoor works at points in the existing pinned OpenStreetMap extracts
selection: The Burghers of Calais in Memorial Court and Angel of Grief in the Arboretum are within the pinned Stanford campus perimeter. Original source point coordinates, node identity and version remain unchanged. The indoor Thinker and unreviewed artworks are not generated.
geometry: Original authored low-poly interpretations from inspected Stanford photographs. Bronze/marble, six separate Burghers plinths and gestures, and the Angel altar, bowed pose and drooping wings are reference based. All dimensions, figure arrangement around the mapped group point, orientation, face details and relief are modeled estimates, not survey measurements, scans or exact replicas. No external models, image textures or remote runtime geometry are used.
